security_justification.audit_integrity: Improves audit integrity by ensuring CI checks accurately reflect script health without false failures triggered by version bumps.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Does not touch authentication, tokens, credentials, or authorization scopes.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority, identity credentials, or cryptographic provenance claims are altered.
security_justification.concurrency: Executes purely synchronously within node:test with no concurrent processes or shared mutable state.
security_justification.confidentiality: Operates strictly in an ephemeral temporary directory with synthetic test strings; no sensitive data is processed or retained.
security_justification.cryptography: Does not introduce, alter, or interact with cryptographic algorithms or keys.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No error disclosure mechanisms, logging pipelines, or diagnostic reporting are modified.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security integrations, third-party network requests, or external APIs are used.
security_justification.fail_posture: The test continues to verify that unexpected git invocations throw errors and fail closed.
security_justification.lifecycle: Operates during test execution in local development and CI status checks; no runtime lifecycle is modified.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Mutations are strictly confined to the unit test file .github/scripts/clean-release-changelog.test.mjs; no production code, manifests, or workflows are touched.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Does not process user telemetry, personal data, or operational payloads.
security_justification.resource_retention: Temporary directories created with mkdtempSync are deterministically cleaned up using rmSync in try-finally blocks.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Deterministic test execution with identical results across repeated runs.
security_justification.trust_boundary: No trust boundary is defined, moved, or crossed. The change only isolates a unit test using a temporary directory fixture.
